name: Andaleeve Rahman Partho
contribution: As chairman of Bangladesh Jatiya Party, he contested the Bhola-1 constituency in the 12 February 2026 parliamentary election as part of the BNP-led alliance and was reported elected. His campaign connected a smaller party's platform to constituency issues in coastal Bhola.
context: Bangladesh's first parliamentary election after the 2024 uprising, held during the transition from interim rule to an elected parliament. Partho's public positions also placed him in debates over the July National Charter, constitutional reform, and the timing and design of elections.
impact: His role illustrates how smaller-party leaders entered the post-2024 parliamentary transition through alliance politics, constituency representation, and public argument over institutional reform. In March 2026, reporting placed him among lawmakers debating whether both the Constitution and the July National Charter should be respected.
highlight: Bangladesh Jatiya Party chairman and Bhola-1 lawmaker in the 2026 parliamentary transition.
